idea: Keep a reusable agent launcher in version control, with daily assignments separate
benefit: Make launch settings reviewable and reusable after temporary files disappear
revisit_when: After the current research wave; before reusing the dated launcher

idea: Review whether each launched desk can use narrower writable paths
benefit: Reduce the chance of accidental edits to another desk while preserving useful shared handoffs

idea: Receipt command: one CLI call verifies a desk commit, files its memo to processed, writes the consumption-ledger line and the ORCH_LOG receipt, commits by pathspec
benefit: Replaces ~5 tool calls per packet; PROME spent ~30 such cycles on 10/14 evening
revisit_when: At the friction audit (10/15 maintenance session); PROME-owned tool, one process change

idea: Desk status one-liner: read-only command printing a desk's local changes, ahead/behind, last delivery, next due DOCKET row and liveness
benefit: Replaces the ListAgents + ps + git log + inbox_census + DOCKET-grep preflight chain run per desk (8x on 10/14)
revisit_when: After the receipt command; feeds the same-minute preflight

idea: Receipt-class auto-filing: packets with no ACTION line and WILL_NEEDS none are filed to processed with their RESULT and GAPS lines printed into the ledger; PROME reads only action packets
benefit: 35 of 40 packets at the 10/14 boot were receipts; 158-packet backlog
revisit_when: After the friction audit measures the share; design constraint: caveats printed, never hidden

idea: Generated restart card: the five restart questions (assignment · done+verified · next authorized action · blockers · read-only-if-needed) rendered from DOCKET/WILL_QUEUE/ORCH_LOG/GATES, replacing hand-written SCRATCH resume prose
benefit: Removes the whole-read of three overlapping summaries at boot and their drift (10/11 review pilot)
revisit_when: After JANUS and the calendar patch land

idea: 'Retires' line on every landed repair naming the rules/reminders it supersedes; the WQ-299 10/25 review strikes them
benefit: Stops rulebook growth; zero build cost
revisit_when: Adopt at the 10/15 maintenance session's completion notes; charter wording is Will's

idea: Diff-driven spine audit: the weekly nine-reader Workflow reads only spine surfaces changed since the last audit
benefit: Most of a Workflow's cost per week
